entries.partTitle: Numerical Integration on GPU: Euler vs Verlet Integration

spec.title: System Architecture: Numerical Integration on GPU: Euler vs Verlet Integration

right.label: Modern WebGPU Compute Pipeline
content: Zero-copy on-chip storage and shared memory

steps.caption: Simulation overview diagrams symplectic Verlet numerical integration and discrete spatial hash cell partitioning across continuous world space.
Detailed inspection traces prime XOR spatial hash generation, cell bucket range tables, and twenty-seven neighbor cell candidate stencils.
Comparative analysis contrasts quadratic pairwise collision bottlenecks against linear amortized spatial grid neighborhood queries.
Physical verification confirms momentum conservation, impulse exchange accuracy, and zero inter-particle penetration overlap.
